incomplete_reviews.handed_to: local session, before the first edit of any node (LOCAL_AGENT_CONTRACT.json:pending_independent_review)
incomplete_reviews.reason: the reviewing agent stopped on an account usage limit before it returned a report; no finding was delivered

findings.resolution: Locking null repeated for three nuisance models with 4000 draws each; class reported per model with a robust class; power of the pole_locked flag measured by injection; H-L5c moved to HOLD and both directional statements withdrawn.
findings.summary: The rejection of pole locking (H-L5c) rested on the pooled nuisance model only; the calibrated tail changes with the zero-point model and the flag has low power.

findings.resolution: Late-time kernel sensitivities and bounds computed; H-L3c rejected as stated and replaced by the conditional statement H-L3d.
findings.summary: H-L3c was promoted although late-time anisotropic stress with a sign-changing shear cancels the temperature functional.

findings.resolution: Inner and outer window nulls added for the pooled and method-monopole models together with the sample composition; H-L5a moved to HOLD as a conditional statement quoted with all three nuisance models. The inner windows are reported as computed.
findings.summary: The excess over the body (H-L5a) is dominated by the outer windows, where the sample is northern FP; only a conditional statement is supported.

findings.resolution: Hemisphere-split axis scan with the exact body and a restricted pair sum; scan-corrected tail, rank of the pole and the variance ratio of the best single family to the common step are reported next to the single-axis tail; the common-dipole Wald tail is quoted.
findings.summary: The tail of the common hemisphere step used an axis chosen after the first pass; the four family estimates are not independent.

findings.resolution: The contradictory sentences were removed, the two measurements are separated in the report, the split result is labelled as not being evidence, and a test blocks the withdrawn phrases.
findings.summary: The report stated both a hemisphere step and that no axis is singled out; the step and the window excess are different measurements; 'absorbed by the split' is near-automatic.

findings.resolution: Forking-path register FP-01 to FP-12 added to THEORY_LOOPS.md; the rule status is recorded in the result file; the wording 'pre-specified' was dropped; self-audit items A14 and A15 added.
findings.summary: Several analysis choices were made after looking at data and the decision rule was described as pre-specified.

findings.resolution: Exact collisionless stress weight for massive species implemented and tested (R54-EQ-06, MG-20); minimal-normal-ordering variant run; full onset sweep with the neutrino temperature at each onset; H-L1b kept as a qualitative statement with illustration numbers.
findings.summary: The present-shear numbers of H-L1b were quoted from a cut sweep with massless neutrinos only.

findings.resolution: Evidence rows E46, E47 and E48 added (E46 and E47 checked by search in this session; the author list of E47 was corrected against the arXiv record); H-L1a is recorded as a re-derivation without a novelty claim; benchmark target B09 added.
findings.summary: The kernel result has prior art that was not cited.

findings.resolution: Injections at the observed sizes on the pooled and method-monopole operators; the decision of H-C3 follows a threshold written before that run was read and is HOLD.
findings.summary: H-C3 said the depth laws are separated although the injected amplitudes exceeded the observed ones.

findings.resolution: H-C1 is recorded as a reporting convention without a novelty claim; the F view is UNAVAILABLE on both low-redshift lanes and the axis scan is filed under Pi.
findings.summary: The five views were presented with a novelty flavour and the F slot of the low-redshift lanes held an axis scan.

findings.resolution: Wording bounded to the stated conditions and listed under limitations. Survey monopoles, a radial slope and a distance-error term are specified as fixed nuisance variants of R54-L04, which needs the raw CF4 tables on the local drive; a calibration covariance and a selection model are not built.
findings.summary: The CF4 null has no calibration covariance, no selection model and no survey labels.

findings.resolution: Specified as the operator log_mono_galactic of R54-L04.
findings.summary: A Galactic-latitude nuisance was not tested.

findings.resolution: Replaced by the exact Wishart ratio with a Monte Carlo unit test; Hotelling tails for the square primary carrier; MG-12 updated; the R53 code is not edited and the difference is recorded as conservative.
findings.summary: The finite-MC inflation formula inherited from R53 is not exact.

findings.resolution: H-L4a moved to HOLD; the family-identification block is kept in the statement.
findings.summary: H-L4a was promoted without a null calibration of the invariants.

findings.resolution: H-L3a and H-L3b carry 'NONE claimed' novelty and the inherited label; the power of the count estimator against a doubled dipole is computed; H-L2a and H-L6b moved to HOLD.
findings.summary: H-L3a and H-L3b are inherited structural statements; H-L2a and H-L6b were rejected on an underpowered count estimator.

findings.resolution: Novelty of H-C3, H-L5a and H-L5g set to LOW pending R54-L07; the ODE agreement is described as inside the unit-test tolerance; the '(met)' clause was removed.
findings.summary: Novelty fields and several small wordings were too strong (tolerance quoted as agreement, a kill criterion marked as met).

reviewers.scope: hypotheses, decisions, statistics and wording of the R54 cloud nodes before the review-driven re-run

rule: Reviewer output is information, not authority. No number proposed by a reviewer entered a document without being re-executed by the run scripts.
